scripts.hash-zome: bash submodules/hc-prebuilt/hash-zome.sh $npm_package_config_bin ./submodules/snapmail-rsm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/snapmail_model.wasm artifacts/snapmail_zome_hash.txt && cp artifacts/snapmail_zome_hash.txt electron/bin
scripts.build:webapp: npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run build -w webapp
scripts.prepare-devtest: npm run clean:agents && npm run build:happ && bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build:webapp
scripts.devtest: npm run prepare-devtest && npm run start:mem
scripts.devtest:we: npm run prepare-devtest && npm run dist -w webapp && HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' npm run devtest -w we-applet
scripts.devtest:electron: npm run prepare-devtest && npm run devtest -w electron
scripts.prodtest: npm run clean:agents && npm run dist -w webapp && HC_PORT=$(port) ADMIN_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:local" "sleep 8 && npm run start:ui -w webapp"
scripts.prodtest:electron: npm run clean:agents && npm run build -w webcomponents && npm run dist -w webapp && npm run prodtest -w electron
scripts.prodtestfull:we: npm run prepare-devtest && npm run dist:we && npm run prodtest:we
scripts.prodtest:we: cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:run" "cross-env AGENT_NUM=1 npm run prodtest:we-launch"
scripts.start:mem: cross-env HC_PORT=$(port) ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run build:watch -w webcomponents" "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 7 && npm run start:ui -w webapp"
scripts.start:local: echo START:LOCAL $INDEX & cross-env HC_PORT=$(port) ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run _save-ports" "npm run build:watch -w webcomponents" "npm run new-sandbox:local" "sleep 7 && npm run start:ui -w webapp"
scripts.new-sandbox:mem: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/snapmail.happ --run=$HC_PORT -a snapmail network mem
scripts.new-sandbox:local: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/snapmail.happ --run=$HC_PORT -a snapmail network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:$SIGNAL_PORT
scripts.serve: cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) SIGNAL_PORT=$(cat .hc_signalenv) npm run serve:run
scripts.serve:save: echo SIGNAL_PORT=$SIGNAL_PORT && echo $SIGNAL_PORT > .hc_signalenv && echo $BOOT_PORT > .hc_bootenv && echo BOOT_PORT=$BOOT_PORT
scripts.restart: HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' HC_PORT=$(port) ADMIN_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run restart:happ" "sleep 8 && npm run start:ui -w webapp"
scripts.network2: npm run prepare-devtest && cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "cross-env INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && cross-env INDEX=1 npm run start:local"
scripts.network3: npm run build:devtest && cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "cross-env INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && cross-env INDEX=1 npm run start:local" "sleep 2 && cross-env INDEX=2 npm run start:local"
scripts.local:sandbox: echo INDEX $INDEX & echo PORTS $BOOT_PORT $SIGNAL_PORT $HC_PORT $ADMIN_PORT & RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$ADMIN_PORT run $INDEX
scripts._local: cross-env BOOT_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) SIGNAL_PORT=$(cat .hc_signalenv) HC_PORT=$(cat .hc_app_$INDEX) ADMIN_PORT=$(cat .hc_admin_$INDEX) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run local:sandbox" "sleep 7 && npm run start:ui-only -w webapp"
scripts.start:launcher: echo pass | hc-launch --piped -n 1 artifacts/snapmail.webhapp network mem
scripts.dist:we: npm run dist -w we-applet && npm run package:we
scripts.package:we: rm -rf artifacts/snapmail-we_applet-ui.zip & cd we-applet/dist && bestzip ../../artifacts/snapmail-we_applet-ui.zip * && cd ../.. && $npm_package_config_bin/hc web-app pack we-applet/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/snapmail-we_applet.webhapp
scripts.dist:electron: bash submodules/hc-prebuilt/copy-binaries.sh electron/bin && npm run dist:build -w electron
scripts.package:webapp: rm -rf artifacts/snapmail-webapp-ui.zip & cd webapp/dist && bestzip ../../artifacts/snapmail-webapp-ui.zip * && cd ../.. && $npm_package_config_bin/hc web-app pack webapp/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/snapmail.webhapp
scripts.dl-test-release: rm -rf release & mkdir -p release & gh release download workflow-test -D release -R glassbeadsoftware/snapmail
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:agents & npm run clean:npm & npm run clean
